verdict.rationale: The service's own pages document the full company-formation flow online. The founder creates the company, the pact is auto-generated from the form and signed digitally inside the platform, payment is made by MBWay, Multibanco or card, and a completion email delivers the company card and permanent certificate codes. The 404 on the eportugal.gov.pt entry URL is a stale link; the live service page on justica.gov.pt still documents the flow, so it does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that an end-to-end incorporation actually completes online, and a working published eportugal entry path.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: No serviço online pode criar sociedades comerciais e sociedades civis do tipo: Sociedade unipessoal por quotas, Sociedade por quotas, Sociedade anónima.
assinar digitalmente o pacto social (pode assinar dentro da plataforma com a Chave Móvel Digital)
Faça o pagamento (MBWay, Multibanco ou Cartão de Crédito).
Se o registo for concluído com sucesso, vai receber um email e os códigos de acesso ao cartão eletrónico da empresa e à certidão permanente comercial.
